cost_scope: Declared mathematical kernel estimates only; data generation/hash/I/O/memory primitives are not priced as operators. All real diagnostic process CPU/wall includes them. Not qualification build cost.
limitations: Critic OOF only: the fixed content encoder saw all TRAIN sources.
No validation threshold tuning, held-out estimate, or qualification claim.
Weighted classifier scores are dimensionless diagnostics at fixed .5; not a drop-in raw-gain/CPU-price law.

protocol.caveat: critic OOF only: fixed encoder itself was trained on entire TRAIN fold; no independent content generalization claim
protocol.fold_group: physical source; sourceclass stratified; all instructions/variants together
protocol.fold_order: sha256(salt + NUL + source_id) per sourceclass, sorted, roundrobin4
protocol.forward_rule: one model._forward(train.low) with retained hidden and p/q plus one model._forward(train.full) per selected NC model; both actual202dim
protocol.intercept: unpenalized; weighted centered normalized features for classifier, ordinary centered features for MSE
protocol.normalization: fold TRAIN unweighted feature mean/std floor.05
protocol.source_weighting: equal physical sources then equal model seeds
protocol.validation_rule: saved validationreceipt decomposition only; no validation data construction
